name: Etna
about: The upper flanks of Etna between the Simeto and the Alcantara valleys: black and rust lava flows of every age and cinder cones, Calabrian pine and Etna birch forest, beech on the north-east flank, Etna broom on young lava and milk-vetch cushions on the high ash slopes below the smoking summit. It needs its own bare ramp and rock for the dark lava; everything else comes from south-apennines.
